qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High switching costs in commercial primary banking relationships and treasury management, combined with toll-booth transaction economics in Elavon merchant acquiring (~26% of enterprise revenue). Empirically demonstrated by 12-15% normalized ROE (18%+ ROTCE) and sticky operational deposits. Primary erosion threats stem from fintech digital payment disruption, interchange fee legislative caps (Credit Card Competition Act), and deposit competition from money market alternatives.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet). High-quality super-regional franchise with valuable Elavon payments integration and capable management, but inherently fails the peace-of-mind fortress balance sheet standard due to structural fractional-reserve banking leverage (~12.4x assets-to-equity), deposit duration/flight risk, and continuous capital retention required by regulatory frameworks rather than unencumbered owner free cash flow generation.
qualitative.evidence: Total assets ~$680B supported by ~$55B equity (~12.4x leverage). FY2024 net income of $6.30B expanded to $7.57B in FY2025 following full operational integration of MUFG Union Bank. ROE improved from 11.7% in 2024 to 13.0% in 2025 (ROA from 0.95% to 1.12%; NIM steady at 2.72%). Payment Services segment contributed $7.41B revenue (~26% of total), led by Elavon with $570B+ acquiring volume. CET1 capital ratio strengthened to ~10.5%+, but structural reliance on ~$500B in deposits and wholesale funding violates Gate 6 peace-of-mind solvency mandate.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
